opportunities.title: Hakluyt Society Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Open to researchers preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society (category A, submitted via the Society's Administrator) or researching projects already approved and under contract (category B, discussed with the assigned Series Editor). Recipients of support need not be members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: The Society supports research undertaken in preparing publication proposals to be submitted to the Society, or research on proposals already approved where volumes are under contract. Payments are made as reimbursements of previously agreed expenditure from the Society's Harry & Grace Smith Fund, in accordance with the Society's charitable objects of advancing education by publishing records of voyages, travels, naval expeditions and other geographical material. Support may relate to a volume for the main series (Series III) or the series Hakluyt Society Studies in the History of Travel.
